invariant: i ≤ a.size ∧ (∃ ii, ii < a.size ∧ ∃ jj, jj < b.size ∧ best = (a[ii]! - b[jj]!).natAbs) ∧ ∀ k, k < i → ∀ j, j < b.size → best ≤ (a[k]! - b[j]!).natAbs

children.prop: (∃ jj, jj < b.size ∧ row = (a[i]! - b[jj]!).natAbs) ∧ ∀ jj, jj < b.size → row ≤ (a[i]! - b[jj]!).natAbs

children.invariant: 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ b.size ∧ (∃ jj, jj < j ∧ row = (a[i]! - b[jj]!).natAbs) ∧ ∀ jj, jj < j → row ≤ (a[i]! - b[jj]!).natAbs

lemmas.name: exit54
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a b : Array Int) (i best : Nat) (h : CanyonSearch_precond a b), (i ≤ a.size ∧ (∃ ii, ii < a.size ∧ ∃ jj, jj < b.size ∧ best = (a[ii]! - b[jj]!).natAbs) ∧ ∀ k, k < i → ∀ j, j < b.size → best ≤ (a[k]! - b[j]!).natAbs) → ¬ i < a.size → CanyonSearch_postcond a b best h
lemmas.proof:
by intro a b i best h hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, ⟨ii, hii, jj, hjj, hb⟩, hall⟩ := hinv
  have hi' : i = a.size := by omega
  subst hi'
  unfold CanyonSearch_postcond
  constructor
  · rw [← Array.any_toList, List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨a[ii]!, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← Refine.toList_getElem_bang a ii hii]; exact Refine.getElem_bang_mem _ _ (by simpa using hii)
    · rw [← Array.any_toList, List.any_eq_true]
      refine ⟨b[jj]!, ?_, by simpa using hb⟩
      rw [← Refine.toList_getElem_bang b jj hjj]; exact Refine.getElem_bang_mem _ _ (by simpa using hjj)
  · rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true, Refine.forall_mem_toList_iff_idx]
    intro k hk
    rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true, Refine.forall_mem_toList_iff_idx]
    intro j hj
    simpa using hall k hk j hj
